_about: Known disruptions with the OTHER countries that published reports say were hit through supply chains. Only countries the engine can rank (our 20 reporting economies) are labels; others are listed in 'not_rankable'. 'confidence' is our own judgement of how directly the source ties the country to this event. Collected Oct 2026 from news/industry reports; it is small and not exhaustive - a country NOT listed was not necessarily unaffected.

cases.name: Great East Japan earthquake and tsunami, March 2011
cases.note: Before our 2019-2023 window: run on today's (2023) graph, so trade links are 12 years newer than the event.

USA.evidence: GM halted its Shreveport, LA pickup plant for a week from 21 March for lack of Japanese parts

FRA.evidence: PSA Peugeot Citroen cut output at European (French) sites after Hitachi diesel-engine parts stopped; ~5,000 workers in France affected

DEU.evidence: Opel cancelled shifts at Eisenach, Germany, for an electronic component sourced from Japan

not_rankable.ESP: Opel Zaragoza shut completely (Spain is not one of our 20 reporters)

cases.name: Thailand floods, Oct-Dec 2011
cases.note: Before our window: run on the 2023 graph.

JPN.evidence: IHS: beyond Thailand the worst-impacted country is Japan (Japanese makers' Thai plants and parts)

USA.evidence: Toyota slowed US car production for lack of Thai-made parts; hard-drive shortage hit US PC makers

cases.name: Texas winter storm (Uri), February 2021
cases.note: Cold waves are not in GDACS, so this is run as a what-if on the USA.

MEX.evidence: Petrochemical shortage after the freeze affected Toyota production in Mexico (as well as Kentucky and West Virginia)

CAN.evidence: Honda halted most US and Canadian car plants citing supply-chain issues including the storm; storm's share unclear

DEU.evidence: Turkish textile exports to the EU fell 26% in Jan-Feb 2023; source names the EU, not member states, and textiles are not one of our 12 products

negative_controls.finding: Subaru's Gunma plant stopped for about a week, but its Indiana plant was not affected and North American supply was not short; Toyota called its disruption minimal. No overseas importer reported as hit.

excluded.ida_2021: Large Louisiana petrochemical shutdowns (16% of US ethylene, 41% of PVC) but no report found naming a foreign country hit. spglobal.com 2021-08-31
excluded.ian_2022: No report found naming a foreign country hit.
excluded.henan_floods_2021: Foxconn said its main Zhengzhou iPhone plant saw no direct impact. freemalaysiatoday.com 2021-07-23
excluded.malaysia_floods_2021: Port Klang and Shah Alam factories (incl. BE Semiconductor's plant) disrupted; no downstream country named. malaymail.com 2021-12-20
excluded.hinnamnor_2022: POSCO Pohang steelworks flooded, but in KOREA - GDACS lists only Japan for this storm; reported knock-on was to Korean shipyards (domestic). koreatimes.co.kr 2022-09-06
excluded.taiwan_drought_2021: TSMC repeatedly said production was not affected, so it is not a confirmed disruption. fortune.com 2021-06-12
